checks.name: ck_proposal_state_hash
checks.sql: (input_hash IS NULL OR length(input_hash) = 64) AND (base_structure_hash IS NULL OR length(base_structure_hash) = 64)

checks.name: ck_proposal_state_origin
checks.sql: (legacy = true AND legacy_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('legacy', 'applied')) OR (legacy = false AND legacy_snapshot IS NULL AND status <> 'legacy')

checks.name: ck_proposal_state_basis
checks.sql: legacy = true OR (target IS NOT NULL AND normalized_input IS NOT NULL AND input_hash IS NOT NULL AND base_date IS NOT NULL AND dependency_versions IS NOT NULL AND preview_response IS NOT NULL AND preview_schema_version IS NOT NULL AND preview_schema_version > 0 AND ((base_plan_id IS NOT NULL AND base_plan_revision IS NOT NULL AND base_plan_revision > 0 AND base_structure_hash IS NULL) OR (base_plan_id IS NULL AND base_plan_revision IS NULL AND base_structure_hash IS NOT NULL)))

checks.name: ck_proposal_state_result
checks.sql: (result_response IS NULL AND result_schema_version IS NULL AND result_captured_at IS NULL AND (status <> 'applied' OR legacy = true)) OR (legacy = false AND status = 'applied' AND result_response IS NOT NULL AND result_schema_version IS NOT NULL AND result_schema_version > 0 AND result_captured_at IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL AND result_captured_at = decided_at)

checks.name: ck_proposal_state_decision
checks.sql: legacy = true OR (status = 'ready' AND decided_at IS NULL) OR (status IN ('applied', 'cancelled', 'stale') AND decided_at IS NOT NULL)
